heading: INT. ORBITAL LAUNDERETTE - ZERO-G - NIGHT CYCLE

units.text: INT. ORBITAL LAUNDERETTE - ZERO-G - NIGHT CYCLE
A drum-shaped room on a space station.
Washing machines turn in the walls like portholes.
Loose socks drift like jellyfish.
Magnetic benches hold a few late-shift residents.
PAXTON (40s, patched coverall, braided beard) floats near the dryer bank with a sack of laundry.
REN (20s, hoodie, cheap vac-boots) types on a handheld.
ULLA (60s, silver hair in a net, folded newspaper) reads upside down.
VASHTI (30s, clean uniform, security patch) stands by the door, hand on a holster.
Ren, that's the third load you've started.
units.name: PAXTON

units.text: It's a long week.
units.name: REN

units.text: You're running a hot cycle. It's against regs.
units.name: ULLA

units.text: It's one sock.
units.name: REN

units.text: Everyone remain calm.
units.name: VASHTI

units.text: A siren whoops.
Red light pulses.
The machines shudder.
Socks scatter.
Paxton and Ren grab the same handhold.
Ulla folds her newspaper and tucks it under her arm.
That's a hull breach klaxon.
units.name: VASHTI

units.text: Where?
units.name: PAXTON

units.text: Dryer six.
units.name: VASHTI

units.text: All four look at dryer six.
Its door bulges outward like a bubble.
Something is knocking from inside.
It's just the sock.
units.name: REN

units.text: That is not a sock.
units.name: ULLA

units.text: The door bursts.
A flood of foam and lost clothing gushes out, followed by a gasping, soapy cat.
It twists in midair, lands on Vashti's chest, and clings.
I'm going to need a bigger form.
units.name: VASHTI

units.text: The siren stops.
The lights return to white.
The four of them hover in the foam, staring at the cat.
